meta.backend: fast_em (numpy Baum-Welch, pyBKT 1.4.3 init ranges/stopping rule)

constraints.selection: best log-likelihood restart; degenerate fits flagged, not refit

difficulty.class_rule: engine get_difficulty_class on d clipped to [D_MIN, D_MAX]: easy d<0.35, medium d<0.65, hard otherwise

degenerate_skills: Angles on Parallel Lines Cut by a Transversal

heuristic.continuous: g=GUESS_COEF*(1-d), s=SLIP_BASE+SLIP_COEF*d, d clipped; unrated d=0.5

heldout.difficulty_note: d recomputed per fold from training students only
